_routing_note: When k8s_defer_to_coordinator is true and a K3s coordinator is active, the K8S.20 distribute_tests formula owns the actual per-machine shard split and these static machine weights are IGNORED. The static machines[] weights (dell 0.88 / windows 0.08 / mint 0.04 (coverage dell 0.88 / windows 0.12)) apply ONLY to the Docker-context fallback path used when the cluster is unavailable. Dell carries the heaviest share because it is the fastest box: an Intel i5-13500T (14 cores / 20 threads). The per-machine max_weight values remain a hard ceiling the coordinator formula must respect.
_coverage_routing_note: Used ONLY by .githooks/check-per-file-coverage.py for the per-commit diff-coverage gate. Two-machine split: Dell measures 88% of staged production files, Windows measures 12%. Same docker_context transport + named-volume (xf_coverage_repo) sync pattern as check-scoped-mutation.py. Fail-open: if Dell is unreachable the gate runs ALL files locally on Windows backend-quality (today's behaviour). The pass/fail semantics are unchanged — only WHERE each file's coverage is measured.
_lint_routing_note: Used ONLY by scripts/run_lint_on_context.py for the opt-in sharded lint/type-check path (ruff, pylint, mypy, bandit) gated on XF_LINT_SPLIT=1. Two-machine split: Dell lints 88% of the changed Python files, Windows 12%. Lint tools are stateless and read-only (no database), so each machine only needs the source synced (xf_lint_repo named volume, same tar+sha256 handshake as check-scoped-mutation.py / check-per-file-coverage.py) plus the xf-linker-backend-quality image. Fail-open: if Dell is unreachable EVERY file is linted locally on Windows backend-quality (today's behaviour). Pass/fail semantics are unchanged — only WHERE each file is linted.
_pytest_routing_note: Used ONLY by scripts/run_pytest_on_context.py for the opt-in sharded pytest path gated on XF_PYTEST_SPLIT=1. Two-machine split: Dell runs 88% of the changed test targets, Windows 12%. UNLIKE lint, these tests touch a database, so Dell runs them against ITS OWN empty Postgres+Redis test stack (docker-compose.dell-test.yml on the xf_dell_test_net network) — never the live Windows database. Same xf_test_repo named-volume + tar+sha256 handshake as the other gates. Fail-open: if Dell is unreachable EVERY target runs locally. Dell runs its whole slice in ONE pytest process against ONE test DB, so there is no within-Dell DB contention; Dell's slice and the local slice hit different databases on different machines so they cannot collide.
